report_name: LOCAL CYCLING AND WALKING INFRASTRUCTURE PLAN
how_pct_was_used: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) was used to validate identified desire lines, forecast potential growth for cycling, and support the identification of the most important routes in the suggested cycle network.
other_tools_developed: Prioritisation framework (Table 5.1) using 20 criteria, and the Assessment and Sifting Tool (EAST) for route feasibility.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP process has secured £3.967m in funding from the Towns Fund (2020/21 to 2025/26) to deliver three strategic cycle routes totaling 4.8km, and has informed the development of the #BrilliantBarrow Town Investment Plan to facilitate physical connectivity and enhance access.
pct_usage_quote: The Abbey Road, A590 Walney Road, Roose Road, Jubilee Bridge converging on the BAE systems and town centre vicinity are by far the most popular routes in all current and future scenarios in the Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT)
